## Purpose

Describe the problem, intended behavior and related issue.

## Changes

Summarize the scope and any alternatives considered.

## Security and compatibility

Explain effects on credentials, authorization, output, platforms or public data. State explicitly when none are expected.

## Verification

List commands or manual checks, actual outcomes and untested environments. For documentation, check links and GitHub rendering; mark diagrams as design views where appropriate.

| Surface | Evidence or `not affected` |
|---|---|
| Repository/Python/Web/Rust checks | |
| Browser and accessibility | |
| Credential store / secret redaction | |
| Database or other real connector | |
| Package install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall | |
| Documentation navigation and facts | |

## Submission checklist

- [ ] Local checks and tests pass.
- [ ] Failure paths and cleanup use synthetic data and were exercised where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private paths or business artifacts are included.
- [ ] Imported material has documented provenance and compatible licensing.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and changelog are updated.
- [ ] Commit sign-off follows the DCO requirements.
- [ ] For imported or externally owned material, recorded license and provenance; did not treat DCO or PR acceptance as commercial relicensing permission.
